citations.narrative:
There is approximately a 50ft section of 10+ft primary enclosure fencing on the south side of the pen that has heaved out
of the ground, resulting in the diamond mesh fencing being raised off the ground from 5 to 9 inches. There is an area of
primary enclosure fencing on the west side in front of the water source approximately 15 ft long that has 5 to 7 inches of
space between the bottom of the diamond mesh fencing and the ground due to heaving of the fence posts. There are
worn areas under the fencing in these areas and through the grass where small mammals appear to be using these
raised areas of fencing to enter the enclosure regularly. The gaps under the fencing are high enough in some areas
where a deer could push their head under the fence, or a coyote or dog could push their way in due to the disrepair.
The lack of repair on primary enclosure fencing that results in gaps large enough for outside animals (dogs/coyote) to gain
entry into the regulated animals area, could result in possible injuries if they were to make contact with the whitetail deer.
The facility must be constructed of such material and of such strength as appropriate for the animals involved. The indoor
and outdoor housing facilities shall be structurally sound and shall be maintained in good repair to protect the animals
from injury and to contain the animals.
To be corrected by: August 22, 2026

There is an outdoor enclosure holding 4 whitetail deer that has a cement water source that has a steady stream of water
that comes from one side, fills the receptacle, while the overflow empties out the other side. The receptacle is
approximately 5ft x 3ft x 8 inches deep, that was full of dirt/grass and debris. The water was dark in color due to the dirt on
the bottom of the cement. There has not been a regular cleaning schedule to keep the water receptacle clean. This is the
only water source for the deer.
The lack of a clean potable water for drinking can be a possible source of health issues for the regulated animals.
All water receptacles shall be kept clean and sanitary.
To be corrected by: The water source was cleaned by the end of the exit interview
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with facility representative.
